# Donut / crater dots -- PLA, nozzle 205C, bed 60C, M221 S100

**Not yet print-tested.** Generated by `ideas_test.mjs donut`; no library function exists for this texture.

Each ring is the library's spiralDisc() with 0.42mm turns, trimmed to the annulus and printed through emitStroke() (0.42 bead, F250), one layer at a time. D6 is the existing circularDot as a solid reference.

Calibration line: `freeformSolid` x=120-180, y=55, printed first. Part fan on (`M106 S255`) after it, off at the end. Textures occupy x 22-69, y 23-87. `verifyLayout` (3mm min gap): ok=true, 0 warnings.

| id | position (x0, y0) | parameters | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | 23.0, 23.0 | OD 3, hole 1.2, wall 0.9, 2 layers (0.4mm), 5 @ 10mm | small ring |
| D2 | 22.5, 32.5 | OD 4, hole 1.6, wall 1.2, 3 layers (0.6mm), 5 @ 10mm | medium ring |
| D3 | 22.0, 42.0 | OD 5, hole 2.5, wall 1.3, 3 layers (0.6mm), 5 @ 10mm | larger ring, half-diameter hole |
| D4 | 21.5, 51.5 | OD 6, hole 3.6, wall 1.2, 3 layers (0.6mm), 5 @ 10mm | thin-walled ring |
| D5 | 21.5, 61.5 | OD 6, hole 3.6, wall 1.2, 5 layers (1.0mm), 5 @ 10mm | as D4 but 1.0mm tall -- a crater |
| D6 | 22.5, 72.5 | solid D 4, 3 layers | CONTROL: solid circularDot, same size/height as D2 |
| D7 | 23.0, 83.0 | OD 3, hole 1.2, wall 0.9, 3 layers (0.6mm), 10 @ 4mm | ring line: rings 4mm apart, nearly touching |

**What to look for**: Can you feel the hole in each size (where does it stop reading as a ring and start reading as a dot)? Compare D2 with D6 directly. Did the small holes (D1, D7) close up with ooze?

Totals: 10302 G-code lines, 128 retractions, 119.9 mm commanded filament.
